summary: CVE-2026-XXXX: V8 subarray set offset out-of-bounds leading to range check bypass. The subarray method on Uint8Array (and similar typed arrays) does not validate the offset parameter, allowing the set method to write beyond the array's bounds and throw a RangeError. In the sandboxed build, this error is not reported as a sandbox violation, but the native range check is bypassed, enabling a denial-of-service. The PoC is audit/poc.js and the documentation is audit/poc.md.
